text: Northstar plan event retention chart: Team 90 days; Enterprise 365 days.

Welcome to the Northstar product briefing. The Team plan costs two thousand four hundred rupees per user per month, billed annually, with a minimum of five users. Team event data is retained for ninety days. Enterprise event data is retained for three hundred and sixty five days. Upgrading cannot restore data that has already expired. The Team API limit is six hundred requests per minute. Enterprise allows three thousand requests per minute. After an HTTP four twenty nine response, respect the Retry After header.
